inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Day two of riding quiet. Today's smaller flight (five herons, younger lead) did not bank, did not slow, did not look down — confirming yesterday's acknowledgment by leaving it in place. The feather is settled along YY's back as a fact, not a question.

inventory.label: Mira's reading-seat (informal)
inventory.notes: Today the seat held a second reading of the same day. Mira's column-heading *morning readings — YY* gained a *midday* sub-row in her firmer hand; the seat-arrangement now extends to whenever-twice-a-day-finds-him. Still informal. Still standing-room. Slightly more clearly his.

inventory.label: two hickory kernels (week 1 of the morning-readings rate)
inventory.notes: Three was the original count. YY ate the smallest one for breakfast today, slowly enough that it counted. Two remain on the back shelf. Next role-fee: weekly cadence — Mira holds to the rate.

inventory.label: one acorn-bit from the lower rocky shoulder
inventory.notes: Pried out of a crack on the stingier lower-shoulder crevice-line. Carried in the cheek through the kit-showing and the second reading at the bend; placed on the back shelf next to the two hickory kernels at sundown.

identity_notes: Late winter has ended — winter-thinning lifted in pieces across the morning's reading, the midday's reading, and the slow walk between. Three saves on the back shelf: two hickory kernels and one acorn-bit.
Yesterday: lead heron banked over the dead pine and looked down once; Mira opened a *morning readings — YY* column for the wing-beat reading.

Today: read the smaller wing-beat to Mira at first light (five herons, younger lead, no bank, no look) — she logged it under his column, no fee (weekly rate set yesterday). Foraged the lower rocky shoulder for one acorn-bit. At midday, on the way home, watched four mother-and-kit pairs make first descents from one vantage on the lower slope; came back to Mira and asked her to open the ledger again. She logged the kit-showing as the column's first non-morning entry. Mira: 'Twice a day, then, when twice a day finds you. The rate is the rate. The role, it turns out, is the role.'
Standing thread: the role widens from morning into whatever-finds-him. The feather rides quiet. The column has two hours in it now.
